description: Mint a 15-minute reusable read-only task embed ticket. Only the person's own Bearer token and their own task are accepted; session cookies, service and delegated tokens cannot mint. Another person's task returns 404. Tickets work only on /embed/task/:id and its events/still reads, never on a write route. Wrong-task or expired tickets return 403. Stored only as SHA-256 hashes, bound to task and requester.
